home.name: Beamline Twin
home.title: Beamline Twin: operate an X-ray absorption beamline in your browser
home.description: Run a working X-ray absorption beamline: monochromator, mirrors, ion chambers and a fluorescence detector. Scan, fit the EXAFS, train on faults and calibrate from your own data.
home.ogAlt: Beamline Twin card: an XAS beamline from the source to the detectors

methods.name: Methods
methods.title: Beamline Twin methods: every model, its source and its checks
methods.description: How the Beamline Twin computes each reading: the tables and FEFF paths behind it, the teaching models, the unit tests that hold each one, and a comparison with a measured copper foil spectrum.
methods.ogAlt: Beamline Twin card: an XAS beamline from the source to the detectors

quantum.name: Quantum XAS
quantum.title: Quantum XAS: an X-ray absorption spectrum computed by a quantum algorithm
quantum.description: Compute an oxygen K edge the way a fault tolerant quantum computer would, with Hadamard tests of the core-excited state's evolution read out shot by shot, and check it against the exact spectrum. Water, carbon monoxide and Li2MnO3 battery cathode clusters.
quantum.ogAlt: Beamline Twin card: an XAS beamline from the source to the detectors
